turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hello there! How's your day treating you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My cheesecake cracked right across the middle. Again. I'm starting to take it personally.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Don't, it happens to everyone. Cracks usually come from baking too hot or cooling too fast.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I bake it at the temperature the recipe says.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Try a water bath. Wrap the tin in foil and set it in a tray of hot water, it keeps the heat gentle and moist.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Turn the oven off when the centre still wobbles slightly, crack the door open, and leave the cheesecake inside for an hour.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hold on a sec, it's supposed to

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: still wobble? I always bake it until it's firm.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's probably the main issue. It sets as it cools. If it's firm in the oven, it's overbaked.
